maya: quick sync — i'm sketching an onboarding gateway that picks probes based on model footprint + customer tier. want quick takes.
ben: sounds good. essential question: which checks are blocking vs advisory?
kai: blocking should be contract-level: tensor shapes, dtype, attention-mask semantics, decode determinism on a tiny golden set.
sophia: agree. also add a deterministic safety probe that runs on canned prompts. safety failures -> fail-closed.
elena: cost note: heavy microbench for 70B+ is expensive. suggest approval threshold when estimated GPU-minutes > 60.
ops-bot: estimate for model "x-instruct-85b-quant" full_microbench = 320 GPU-mins -> approval required.
maya: good — we'll charge to team credits or require explicit approval. also propose 4 buckets: tiny, small, medium, large with different default probes.
ben: runtime boundary question: kv-cache semantics — should onboarding verify prefix correctness or leave eviction behavior to runtime?
kai: onboarding verifies basic prefix and retrieval semantics. eviction / performance under sustained throughput should be runtime-only.
sophia: admission artifacts must include a machine-readable admit_token with metadata: model_hash, export_cfg, buckets, bench_summaries, run_ids, hw_tags. runtime rejects tokens older than X days or with shim_applied=true if runtime doesn't support shim.
maya: +1. token example: {model: "x-85b", hash: "sha256:...", admit: {level: "partial"}, benches: [{name: "latency_smoke", status: "pass", hw: "H100", run: "r42"}]}
elena: we need golden input sets per (bucket, domain) — small, synthetic and non-copyrighted. bench must report variance and a pass/fail threshold.
ben: for regressions we should keep time-series baselines and automatic alerting when metric delta > configured tolerance.
ops-bot: recommend labeling bench results with hw_type (A100/H100) and image_tag used.
kai: fallback strategy: if heavy bench times out, allow graded admission: experimental flag + canary (qps capped) and extra telemetry for 24h. but safety or contract failures remain fail-closed.
sophia: agree — define mandatory gates for full admission: compile_ok, decode_consistency (<1% on golden), safety_clear, latency_within_tier. everything else advisory.
maya: also add "fast-entry" mode that runs minimal checks and marks model experimental; useful for internal devs.
elena: infra: microbench runners must be multi-hw aware and store bench artifacts in registry with provenance + checksums. ephemeral creds for bench runs and audit logs required.
ben: interface: onboarding emits admit_token + bench_artifact_url + provenance. runtime uses admit_token.tags for routing (canary, experimental, full).
kai: action items: maya will draft config schema for gateway; ben will design admit_token proto; sophia will prepare golden inputs; elena will wire approval flow with ops-bot.
maya: thanks — i'll post a short RFC draft by wed. please add anything else here.
sophia: add test for shim detection: if shim used but runtime lacks shim, onboarding must flag and reject or require shim-support label.
ben: tiny nit: make sure golden inputs avoid PII.
maya: noted. closing thread, will follow up with RFC. :thumbsup:
